name: Tonewell
subtitle: Tonewell for iPad
description: Tonewell, from the LRCDF project: one-click portrait retouch, all on the device.

apps.name: Tonewell
apps.subtitle: One-click portrait retouch
apps.localizedDescription: Tone looks and skin retouch (frequency separation) on the iPad, offline.

privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: Tethered shooting by cable: read photos newly taken on a camera connected with a USB cable.
privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Tethered shooting: receive photos your camera sends over your local network using its FTP auto-transfer.
privacy.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Save your retouched photos to your photo library.
privacy.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Choose photos from your library to retouch.

versions.localizedDescription: Tonewell 0.3.2: sliders show the picture live again with Noise reduction on; Remove spots no longer leaves pale, flat patches on large areas of acne, and dark spots no longer turn pink.

Tonewell 0.3.1: pictures appear sooner, no pause the first time a slider is used, JPEG/HEIC face areas no longer one row off, and models downloaded for an earlier version are no longer used after an update.
Tonewell 0.3: fine control over face and body, settings for each person, photo selection, 20 languages, much faster sliders; optional age model download.
